map.孕周与预产期计算器。按末次月经估算当前孕周与预产期（EDC），提示实际分娩可前后: Gestational-age and due-date calculator. Estimates current gestational age and due date (EDC) by last menstrual period, noting actual delivery may vary by +/-2 weeks, for pregnancy self-management reference.
map.EDD = LMP + 280 天（40 周）；当前孕周 = 距LMP天数/7: EDD = LMP + 280 days (40 weeks); current gestational age = days since LMP / 7

map.科普：理解 Naegele 280 天规则与排卵日关系: Popular science: understand the Naegele 280-day rule and its relation to ovulation day
map.：算法：孕周 = 停经天数 ÷ 7；距预产期 = 280 − 停经天数（Naeg: : algorithm: gestational age = amenorrhea days / 7; days to due date = 280 - amenorrhea days (Naegele rule, pregnancy about 280 days); days to ovulation = amenorrhea days - ovulation day. Actual delivery is usually within +/-2 weeks of the due date.
map.：例1（停经 100 天、排卵日 14）：孕周 = 100/7 = 14.3 周: : example 1 (amenorrhea 100 days, ovulation day 14): gestational age = 100/7 = 14.3 weeks, days to due date = 280-100 = 180 days, days to ovulation = 100-14 = 86 days. Example 2 (amenorrhea 200 days): gestational age 28.6 weeks, days to due date 80 days, days to ovulation 186 days.

Drug dosage, infusion rate, and anticoagulation/thrombolysis decisions must follow the drug label, clinical guidelines and the attending physician's judgment; for emergencies such as chest pain, breathing difficulty or altered consciousness, seek medical care immediately.
map.以早期 B 超（尤其孕 7–13 周头臀长）核定孕周更准；末次月经法前提是周期规: Early ultrasound (especially 7-13 week crown-rump length) is more accurate for dating; the LMP method assumes a regular ~28-day cycle with ovulation around day 14.
map.预产期一定准吗？: Is the due date necessarily accurate?
map.仅约 5% 婴儿恰在预产期出生，多数在 ±2 周内；它是计划产检与分娩的参考点，: Only about 5% of babies are born exactly on the due date, most within +/-2 weeks; it is a reference point for scheduling prenatal visits and delivery, not a precise date.
